task.title: Add a mechanism for switching to a new project key ID
task.description:
A project shouldn't be bound to a single task identifier (ID) prefix created only at setup, such as "WB-<task-hash>". A team may want at some point to switch task IDs, or even have more than one ID. IDs serve to carry simple identification of tasks for a project, and that isn't limited to one single ID set on project creation.
We want to update workbook to handle multiple task ID keys per project, using the CLI or the config page to edit.
Creating a new ID and "retiring" an old one doesn't change anything about existing task IDs, so the system by default would deal with multiple co-existent IDs, but new tasks would be created with the new ID.
Creating a "secondary" ID would allow task creation via the CLI or web to choose which ID to assign a new task. Having multiple IDs allows for additional nuance such as sub-team management, project versions, a project name change, etc.
